issue.title: Guided album schema field rename and choice merge migrations
issue.description: Plan: plan:202611/album_schema_render_and_edit.md, Integration and land-agent acceptance item 4. Current v1 intentionally refuses stored field/choice key renames and merges. Add a separately planned migration flow for field.rename and choice.merge: preview complete affected-record counts, preserve unrelated record bytes, update dependent schema/index references, refuse stale or unsafe inputs atomically, and write album plus affected records plus rebuilt index in one guarded scoped commit with a reversible normal-edit path. Keep JavaScript presentation-only. This is deferred capability, not an unresolved v1 defect. Duplicate audit: feature and all-task searches for field.rename, choice.merge, album/schema migrations; all tasks created in the last week; and all active epic scopes found no matching owner. Active bank setup uses similar guarded infrastructure but does not implement album data migrations.

task_type_fields.proposal: Plan a guarded album field.rename and choice.merge migration flow, with complete dry-run impact counts and span-preserving record rewrites in one reversible transaction.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved bob-cli-kr v1 explicitly refuses these data-migrating operations and defers them to a separate v2 flow; completion of v1 does not depend on them.

issue.creation_reason: The approved bob-cli-kr closeout explicitly defers data-migrating schema edits to v2 and requires a separate tracker so the safe v1 editor can close.
